'''2X-3KPR''' was a [[KPR security droid/Legends|KPR security droid]] manufactured by [[Lerrimore Droids]].<ref name="CCG" /> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was one of several KPR servant droids owned by [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. 2X-3KPR was responsible for patrolling the perimeter of the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], and was programmed to activate [[Alarm system/Legends|alarm]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], security lights, and [[Power fence/Legends|power fences]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|larsmoisturefarm|Lars moisture farm}}</ref>
